review_text: Slightly hidden just along the highway. This shop was too warm inside, with a second floor and some parking. Crunchy nachos were shareably-sized for three. Latte, way too sweet. The timing was a mistake with the group of loud office employees that hour on the next table. Pleasant staff. Ample food choices that’s reasonable. If I’m in the area this is on my most-likely-to-visit for snacks.
